statement: The function returns a result r and does not fail. Let a subarray nums[l..k] be called valid when 0 <= l <= k < len(nums) and its elements are pairwise distinct, i.e. nums[a] != nums[b] for every l <= a < b <= k. Then r is the maximum, over all valid subarrays, of the sum nums[l] + nums[l+1] + ... + nums[k]. Equivalently: every valid subarray has sum <= r, and some valid subarray has sum exactly r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exist indices l,k with 0 <= l <= k < len(nums) such that nums[l],...,nums[k] are pairwise distinct (nums[a] != nums[b] for every l <= a < b <= k) and r = nums[l] + nums[l+1] + ... + nums[k].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and, for every l,k with 0 <= l <= k < len(nums) such that nums[a] != nums[b] for all l <= a < b <= k, we have nums[l] + nums[l+1] + ... + nums[k] <= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and, if nums[i] = nums[0] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), then r = nums[0].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and, if nums[a] != nums[b] for every 0 <= a < b < len(nums), then r = nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[len(nums)-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail, overflow, or panic) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exist indices l,k with 0 <= l <= k < len(nums) such that nums[l],...,nums[k] are pairwise distinct, r = nums[l] + nums[l+1] + ... + nums[k], and this subarray is maximal with respect to one-step extension: if l > 0 then nums[l-1] = nums[t] for some t with l <= t <= k, and if k < len(nums)-1 then nums[k+1] = nums[t] for some t with l <= t <= k.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10000. All indices are 0-based.
